name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new module, page, or capability
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**What are you proposing?**
A clear description of the feature.

**Where does it belong?**
- [ ] Analysis mode (a new physics module or an extension of an existing one)
- [ ] Engine Design mode (component solving, geometry, etc.)
- [ ] Shell / navigation / UI-only

**Why isn't this covered by an existing page?**
If it's physics, please note whether it changes a frozen contract (see
[Known limitations](../../README.md#known-limitations) and
[Verification and freeze status](../../README.md#verification-and-freeze-status))
— that changes the bar for accepting it considerably, since frozen contracts
were verified in gated campaigns and changing them is a scientific decision,
not a routine addition.

**Would you be willing to implement it?**
This is a solo-maintained project — a feature is much more likely to land if
it comes with a PR, or at least a concrete plan for the physics behind it.
